metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code built with the plugin function-hooks API.

plugins.name: session-info
plugins.description: Session pane: context, cost and turns, live plan usage bars, running agents, the last build and test run, the Git state of the repository and its submodules, and a treeview of the files this session created, modified or deleted.

plugins.name: topic-guard
plugins.description: Before a prompt enters the session, a small model judges whether it starts a separate topic; Enter keeps it here, New session clears the session for it.
